hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs) command -v cargo >/dev/null && cargo fmt -- "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac

[ -f Cargo.toml ] || exit 0; out=$(just ci-fast 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -c 3000 >&2; echo 'just ci-fast failed; reproduce it with `just t <crate>` and fix it there before committing' >&2; exit 2; }

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q '\.snap' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|( ])(sed|mv|rm)( |$)'; then echo 'Snapshots: use `cargo insta accept`. Never sed, mv or rm a .snap file by hand.' >&2; exit 2; fi
